lines: Johnson played 23% of snaps over his last 3 games and 22% for the season, so his role is small and steady.
His carries rose to 8.3 per game over the last 3, up from 6.5 on the season, and he averaged 5.6 PPR points per game.
Week 12 is at LA, which allows the 31st-most PPR points per game to RBs. The coach said he will be used on plays where he doesn't get the ball.
